hook: MI5 accepted giving evidence based on lies to 3 courts.

sections.voiceover: MI5 accepted giving evidence based on lies to 3 courts.
sections.visual_cue: Close-up of official British court documents stamped with evidence markers on a mahogany desk.

sections.voiceover: The service was defending a violent neo-Nazi informer known as Agent X. Oversight findings revealed that senior officers were repeatedly dishonest. How far did senior officers go to protect Agent X?
sections.visual_cue: Archival security footage effect overlaying classified surveillance file labelled Agent X.
sections.sfx_cue: Subtle camera shutter and paper rustle.

sections.voiceover: But Lord Leveson stated these lies were as serious as anything he had ever dealt with.
sections.visual_cue: Formal portrait shot of Investigatory Powers Commissioner Lord Leveson in official chambers.
b_roll: High Court corridor silhouetted walking shot

sections.voiceover: An IPCO report found one senior officer lied repeatedly during the case. A second officer misled his colleagues about what he was told. MI5 officially accepted giving dishonest evidence to 3 courts.
sections.visual_cue: Split-screen graphic showing two anonymous senior officer silhouettes beside investigative report excerpts.

sections.voiceover: The Investigatory Powers Commissioner's Office report confirms MI5 misled the courts during this entire case.
sections.visual_cue: Wide cinematic tracking shot of Thames House reflecting off the River Thames at twilight.
sections.sfx_cue: Deep resonant low frequency hum fading out.
